mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign (id, name, starts_at, ends_at, status) VALUES (#{record.id}, #{record.name}, #{record.startsAt}, #{record.endsAt}, #{record.status})
INSERT INTO campaign (id, name, starts_at, ends_at, status, owner_user_id) VALUES (#{record.id}, #{record.name}, #{record.startsAt}, #{record.endsAt}, #{record.status}, #{ownerUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE campaign SET name = #{name}, starts_at = #{startsAt}, ends_at = #{endsAt}, status = 'DRAFT' WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED')
UPDATE campaign SET status = 'PENDING_REVIEW', submitted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
